## Objective

Deliver four reading destinations with stable identities, source evidence and supported process semantics.

## Scope

- Implement shared read client, state and safe route foundations
- Implement semantic reader shell and Overview
- Implement discoverable accessible search and browsing
- Implement faithful entries and evidence drawer
- Implement source-supported process reading

## Entry conditions

- Phase 2 read/service/launch contracts pass; implement the shared API/state/route foundation before attaching screen consumers.

## Exit criteria

- Overview, discovery, entries, routes/preferences and ordered/unordered process flows satisfy their current acceptance cases.

## Risks

- Absent source facts must remain absent; source bodies and authentication values cannot enter durable UI state.

## TASK-012 - Implement shared read client, state and safe route foundations

Implement one versioned API client and explicit state transitions for identity, focus, search/filter, snapshot, expansion, source selection and preferences; encode stable-ID hash routes and transient session handling before screen consumers are connected.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-012, REQ-013, REQ-015, REQ-020, REQ-025, REQ-030, REQ-035 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer/src/api.ts, SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer/src/state.ts, SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer/src/routes.ts, SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer/src/preferences.ts, SKILLS-depo/ontology/explorer/tests/state.test.ts |
| Dependencies | TASK-002, TASK-005, TASK-006, TASK-007, TASK-009, TASK-010, TASK-011 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Pure state transitions preserve distinct identity/focus/query/filter/snapshot/expansion/source/preference fields and reject obsolete response sequences even when cancellation loses a race.
- Route codecs encode exact IDs and safe view state; bootstrap/session values and source bodies cannot enter copied links, history state or durable preference storage.
- Selection emits one navigation event, camera changes emit none, snapshot conflict retains old coherent context, and explicit refresh discards incompatible cursor/expansion state atomically.
- Only the shared read client initiates allowed reads; later screens and renderer consume state and emit intentions. Browser-level Back/Forward and focus integration are assigned to TASK-019.

### Planned verification

- Run pure route/state tests for IDs, query/filter round trips, late entry-A-after-B responses, cancelled requests, snapshot conflict/refresh and preference reset.
- Test bootstrap consumption and safe desired-route restoration with a stubbed session exchange; inspect serialized route/preferences for forbidden secrets or source content.

## TASK-014 - Implement discoverable accessible search and browsing

Build compact results, alphabetical/category browse, removable filter chips, preserved query empty states and optional accessible autocomplete using deterministic API responses.

| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Visible labeled search and submit work without shortcuts; autocomplete follows Arrow/Enter/Escape behavior without deleting query.
- Results show supported category, preferred label, recorded excerpt and distinctions; lower-frequency filters remain under one control.
- All bound/incomplete/empty cases preserve query and offer useful narrow/clear/continue actions without invented totals.

### Planned verification

- Browser-test AT-02 through AT-06 including multi-page filtering and ambiguity; verify no automatic identity selection.
- Keyboard-test suggestions, announcements and focus while typing/cancelling; a late prior query cannot replace current results.

### Acceptance criteria

- Definitions/aliases/scope/examples/non-examples remain exact; historical status, source freshness and authority meanings are distinct with warnings by affected information.

## TASK-016 - Implement source-supported process reading

Project supported process fields with numbered source-backed order when recorded and preserve the exact missing-order text when sequence is absent or ambiguous.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-001, TASK-006, TASK-007, TASK-015, TASK-012 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Purpose/applicability/roles/inputs/outputs/skills/documents/order each link to exact selected canonical or source support; unsupported fields are omitted.
- Absent ordering displays exactly: An ordered description has not been recorded. These are the documented relationships.
- Paths/dependencies/layout are never inferred as process execution order; process pages execute nothing, and no additional graph library or authoring is introduced.

### Planned verification

- Run AT-17, AT-18 with supported ordered, unordered, ambiguous branch and stale/missing source examples.
- Compare displayed sequence/branches to source sections; inspect process navigation through keyboard and source drawer.
